idea-plugin.name: Lattice
idea-plugin.description:
Lattice — In-App Database Manager for IntelliJ IDEA

A database client for IntelliJ IDEA. Connect to, explore, query, create, and modify your databases without leaving your editor.

Key Features:

  • Supported Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, HSQLDB and H2 with bundled, downloadable or local JDBC drivers. HSQLDB supports file, memory and server connections; H2 supports memory, file and TCP connections.
  • Reusable JDBC Drivers: Download a driver version once and reuse it across connections and IDE restarts, or select a local JAR. Driver discovery runs in the background, supports Maven project defaults, and validates cached JARs before reuse.
  • Database Explorer: Group and filter connections by engine; search sources, schemas, tables and columns. Browse cached metadata offline. Startup and database-change refreshes preserve expanded branches, selection and scroll position.
  • Interactive Data Grid: Inline cell editing with early type checking, auto-generated key protection, periodic auto-refresh, add/delete rows, batch commit, revert, filter (WHERE clause), a Clear filter action, and pagination. Actions reflect selection, pending edits and busy states.
  • Value Inspector: Inspect formatted/raw values and column details beside the grid. Edit values or choose NULL/default, explicitly stage changes, and recover unconfirmed drafts.
  • SQL Query Console: Execute queries with Ctrl+Enter, result tables, affected row counts, elapsed time, query history, timeouts and cancellation.
  • Visual Table Design: Create and alter tables with column navigation and complete SQL previews. Batch column changes, rename tables and retain unfinished edits after partial DDL failures.
  • Export: Export data directly to CSV, JSON, and SQL INSERTs, and export/view CREATE TABLE DDL.
  • What's New: Illustrated, offline feature guides in an editor tab, with a dismissible once-per-version update notice.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1 or later and the IDE's Java 21+ runtime. This is an alpha release; see the project documentation for database compatibility and limitations.

Coming soon:

The roadmap includes generating POJOs, DTOs and JavaBeans; SQL syntax highlighting and schema-aware inline suggestions, subject to platform feasibility; and table relationship graphs and dependency trees. These features are not available yet.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Connect to PostgreSQL and H2 alongside MySQL and HSQLDB; search and filter grouped data sources.
  • Inspect values and column details, keep NULL/default choices in drafts, and stage changes before committing.
  • Review complete SQL previews in the redesigned create/alter table dialogs.
  • Browse cached metadata offline; refresh saved connections on startup while preserving the explorer's expansion, selection and scroll position.
  • Read illustrated, offline release guides from What's New in Lattice, with a once-per-version update notice.
